text:
Marco (Acct Manager): Customer Skylark flagged a surprise charge on INV-0423 after their migration weekend. They say they were told migration traffic would be covered. Can finance confirm?
Sam (FinOps): Got the invoice. There's a 39.2M token overage on skylark-prod-4 for Mar. That lines up with the 2026-03-12 migration window.
Priya Shah: Sharing quick snapshot: reserved_allowance=140M, total=179.2M, overage=39.2M. Rate in contract = $0.00030/token for overage.
BillingBot: meter_summary: commit=skylark-prod-4 period=2026-03-01..2026-03-31 peak_window=2026-03-12T02:30Z..2026-03-12T07:10Z overage_tokens=39200000 overage_charge=$11,760
Marco (Acct Manager): The customer insists they had verbal confirmation from our solutions engineer. Do we have an authorization record?
Liam O'Connor: I checked our Slack thread with the solutions team. There's a message thread but no formal signed approval. We do have a support ticket where SE said "we'll enable temporary burst" but not a billing approval.
Tessa (Legal): Contract reads that burst >4h/day needs written approval per SOW section 2.4. Verbal approvals are not billable unless followed up by email approval.
Elena (Revenue): From revenue side, recommend offering a one-time goodwill adjustment while we gather docs. If recurring, we escalate to revise SOW.
Sam (FinOps): Proposal: place invoice INV-0423 on hold, open dispute D-1794579999, and apply a provisional credit of 40% of the overage ($4,704) while we reconcile.
Marco (Acct Manager): I'll tell the customer we've paused collection and are investigating. Goodwill amount okay?
Priya Shah: Can we get route-level breakdown (chat vs embeddings vs batch) and dedupe for retries? If a large portion is retries due to 503s, we should consider refunding those tokens.
Liam O'Connor: Runtime shows increased 5xx rate during the migration window. Sending trace IDs and the retry count per request to Sam.
BillingBot: export_ready: /billing-exports/skylark/2026-03/lineitems_v2.csv (access: finance-team)
Sam (FinOps): I pulled the CSV and started a dedupe script. Early look: ~9.5M tokens look like client retries; ~6M look like embeddings bursts from a bulk job.
Tessa (Legal): Keep written log of all communications. If we finalize a credit, log the rationale and have account sign an acknowledgement if we deviate from standard billing.
Elena (Revenue): We'll mark revenue recognition hold for the disputed amount. Sam, update the AR ticket and copy me.
Marco (Acct Manager): I'll message the customer now: "We're investigating, invoice on hold, provisional credit applied, will follow up by EOD PST."
Sam (FinOps): Done: AR ticket updated (AR-9876), invoice status -> disputed, provisional credit applied = $4,704, dispute_id = D-1794579999.
BillingBot: invoice_update: INV-0423 status=disputed dispute_id=D-1794579999 provisional_credit=4704
Priya Shah: ETA for final reconciliation: EOD tomorrow. I'll include the per-route CSV and retry dedupe results.
Liam O'Connor: Shared traces with Sam + Elena.
Marco (Acct Manager): Thanks team. Will keep customer updated.
Sam (FinOps): TL;DR: INV-0423 paused, dispute opened, provisional credit 40% applied, action items: Priya (usage breakdown + dedupe), Liam (traces), Marco (customer comms), Tessa (contract check).
Elena (Revenue): If recon finds platform faults account for >25% of overage, recommend full reversal of that portion.
Marco (Acct Manager): Noted. Follow-up meeting scheduled tomorrow 10am PT.
Priya Shah: Will post CSV link in the ticket when ready.
Sam (FinOps): Closing thread for now. Will post final outcome in AR-9876.
